atoms.text: Next, Tina is going to show you some ports around the world.

instruction.text: Select the three images of ports around the world.

feedback.finish: Ports are very important everywhere! They’re needed for bringing in products from other places that can’t be made locally, as well as for selling and shipping things to other places.
feedback.wrong: This is a ski resort on a mountain in Europe.

instruction.text: This is the Port of Shanghai in China. Select one of the containers to learn more.

feedback.end: This is the busiest container port in the world! It ships huge numbers of containers, which are large metal crates full of products, across both the river and the sea.

instruction.text: This is the Port of Hamburg in Germany. Select the ship to learn more.

feedback.end: This port is over 800 years old and has been one of the main ports in Europe for hundreds of years. There’s plenty of space along the port for warehouses to store things.

instruction.text: This is the Port of New York and New Jersey in the USA. Select the land to learn more.

feedback.end: This is the busiest port in the USA! It is in a natural harbour, which is an area of land by the coast that is sheltered from the open ocean. This port is different from the many harbours built by humans.

instruction.text: Drag the images of food to the places they come from.

hint.text: Select an image to hear what it is.

feedback.finish: A lot of products can only be found in certain places around the world. This is why we need ports to get things we can’t find in our own country.

instruction.text: Let’s do some fieldwork! Tina wants to help these cargo ships from the Port of New York and New Jersey get to other ports. Answer her questions.

atoms.a: “In which direction is the Port of Liverpool in England?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>In which direction is the Port of Liverpool in England?</prosody></voice>

atoms.a: “In which direction is Santos Port in Brazil?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>In which direction is Santos Port  in Brazil?</prosody></voice>

atoms.a: “In which direction is the Port of Casablanca in Morocco?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>In which direction is the Port of Casablanca in Morocco?</prosody></voice>

atoms.a: “In which direction is Nuuk Port and Harbour in Greenland?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f5_2025'><prosody pitch = '-2st'>In which direction is Nuuk Port and Harbour in Greenland?</prosody></voice>
